title: TRACE RAC code supplement: failure-injection corpora and prospective LLM holdout
description: Companion artifact for the paper Trust Is Not a Score: Runtime Assurance Contracts for High-Risk AI Agents (arXiv:2609.39717). Version 1.1.0 adds failure_injection/: case files (patches and labels) of the deterministic failure-injection study in agentic coding, for 174 distinct mechanisms and for an independent 124-case corpus written blind by a model of another vendor, with the decision logs reported in arXiv v2 and scripts that recompute the counts. The 280-case corpus reported in arXiv v1 is withdrawn, because most of its cases were index clones, and is not distributed. The repository root holds the prospective synthetic holdout (24 episodes, 72 action attempts) comparing a Runtime Assurance Contract implementation with a separately written full stateful baseline against labels from two blinded LLM judges; its files are unchanged. All cases are synthetic. The private gate implementation is not included.
